text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED: Dedicated pool 'resv-d-chi-01' reported sustained GPU util > 95% and queue growth. Auto-scaler attempts failing.
laura: Pager: resv-d-chi-01 - GPUs 98% util, queue length 480 -> 1.5k in last 3m. Throttling active. Seeing error in autoscaler logs: `ScaleUpError: quota_exceeded`.
samir: Ack, I'm on it. Taking incident command. Severity P1. Can someone confirm customer impact? @emily?
emily: FinVantage (enterprise, reserved) reporting 503s from our API, SDK timeouts. CS on customer bridge. They see spikes since 21:12 UTC.
raj: Autoscaler shows repeated 429/403 from cloud API: `{"error":"QuotaExceeded","code":403}`. Looks like we hit regional vGPU quota for account. Attempts to create nodes blocked.
laura: Also seeing noisy tenant sessions from tenant-id=alpha-ops with long-running batches eating 60% of queue.
samir: Short-term mitigations: 1) throttle per-tenant concurrency for reserved pool, 2) evict long idle sessions from noisy tenant, 3) route non-enterprise traffic to hosted fallback.
raj: Commands:
```
# throttle config push
redwood route update resv-d-chi-01 --max-concurrency=2 --fallback=model-small
# evict noisy tenant sessions
evict-sessions --pool resv-d-chi-01 --tenant alpha-ops --older-than 120s
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout queued: `route update resv-d-chi-01` -> canary on 2 nodes. Use `--force` to bypass approvals.
henry: I'm taking oncall for infra. Pinging cloud support for quota increase, but likely >30m. Will request emergency quota and try manual node add.
infra: Submitted support ticket #CLD-928312 to provider, emergency quota request, ETA initial response 10-20m.
emily: On customer bridge: FinVantage asked for ETA. Told them we're throttling noisy sessions and routing them to hosted spare capacity. They want progress updates.
samir: Execute throttles now. laura, run the eviction and push route update. raj, prepare warm pool spin-up plan.
laura: Eviction started. Responses:
```
evict-sessions --tenant alpha-ops --removed=126 sessions
```
Queue dropped from 1.5k -> 420 in 3m.
laura: Route update pushed to canary. Deploy-bot: canary healthy on 2 nodes. Traffic shift 10% -> fallback.
deploy-bot: Canary passed health checks. Rolling to 20%.
raj: Warm pool 'warm-resv-2' spin plan:
- allocate 4x A10g (preemptible) in us-east-1
- bootstrap runtime image
- attach to resv routing rules
Manual `create-reserved-gpu --count 4 --type a10g --region us-east-1` failed due to same quota.
henry: Ok trying manual scaling at hypervisor level (add warm nodes via spare node groups). If that fails, we'll route enterprise traffic to hosted-dedicated fallback with SLA note.
samir: Emily please keep FinVantage updated: told them we mitigated noise and are provisioning capacity; ETA 20-30m for capacity or fallback routing full.
emily: Acknowledged, posting update to customer bridge.
ops-bot: Alert muted for resv-d-chi-01 for 10m to reduce noise: `alerts mute resv-d-chi-01 --duration 10m`.
laura: After eviction + throttling + routing, observed error rate for FinVantage drop from 18% -> 3% in last 5m. They're back to degraded but functional.
henry: Cloud support responded: they can increase quota but need org owner approval and 45 min lead time. Not helpful.
raj: Alternative: spin up temporary hosted-capacity nodes and apply tenant pinning for FinVantage. That will cost overage but quick. Need approval.
samir: Approve emergency hosted failover for FinVantage. Finance notified. Emily move them to hosted-rescue pool `hosted-emergency-1`, pin tenant.
emily: Pinning started. Command:
```
route pin --tenant finvantage --pool hosted-emergency-1 --duration 4h
```
laura: Pin complete. Traffic shifted. FinVantage error rate now ~0.4%, latency stable.
samir: Good. Closing active mitigation. henry, continue to push on quota and infra scaling. Assign postmortem owner.
henry: I'll own postmortem. Timeline + RCA + action items in #postmortems. Tentative P0 -> RCA within 72h.
emily: Customer notified of mitigation and offered credits per SLA. They're satisfied for now.
laura: Unmute alerts. `alerts unmute resv-d-chi-01`.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Mitigations applied, customer failover in place, infra follow-up required. Incident closed at 21:49 UTC. Postmortem owner: henry.
samir: Thanks team — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
henry: Filing postmortem and scheduling follow-up meeting tomorrow 1600 UTC. :calendar:
laura: Closing thread, adding logs to incident ticket.
